verdict.rationale: Bland documents batch calls for high-volume campaigns via CSV upload and describes dedicated, isolated infrastructure for enterprise customers, which suggests it can scale call volume. Nothing in the pack documents concurrency limits or shows self-serve scaling of simultaneous calls without contacting the vendor. missing for 10: published concurrency limits or quotas per plan, documented self-serve scaling of simultaneous calls, evidence that capacity increases need no manual request, independent or hands-on corroboration of high concurrency.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Batch calls let you initiate high-volume call campaigns by uploading a list of recipients via CSV.
Every enterprise customer on Bland runs on their own isolated infrastructure — dedicated compute, dedicated containers, and dedicated resources.
